name: Honda CBR250R
intro: A simple learner sport bike. Some owners report stalling when downshifting to a stop.

G: If it stalls when you pull the clutch to stop, check idle speed and the throttle body first.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Stalling on downshift
known.what: Owners have reported the engine dying when downshifting with the clutch in. NHTSA looked into it and closed the case.
